name: Conventions page: seeded candidates, accept / reject / edit survive a reload, Create skill lands on /skills
description: HW02 D20 (#44, #46-#50, #52). The ONLY writing flow of the suite: it accepts, rejects and edits the seeded candidates of acme/payments-api, then creates the repo-conventions skill linked to General Reviewer. It needs a FRESH seed (hermetic stack or CI) and runs last, after every read-only flow — it changes skill and agent-link counts that 08 asserts. Every find … click is preceded by a wait --text for its target (flows-contract authoring rules). Clicks on per-card buttons (Accept / Reject / Edit / Save) and on the modal's Create skill are evals scoped to the card's aria-label or to [role=dialog], because several buttons share those names. No model call: the scan is seeded.
